package.title: 王城罗德尔（玛利喀斯前正常状态）

record.label: 大道旁露台
record.description: 王城赐福清单中的大道旁露台；Eldenpedia 路线指南将其描述为王城路线分叉点。

record.label: 巨龙石翼上行段
record.description: 从大道旁露台向高处前进的入口地标；这是路线语义节点，不是原始地图坐标。

record.label: 黄金树大教堂
record.description: 古兰桑克斯的雷电路线起点赐福；默认路线要求该赐福已激活。

record.label: 大教堂西侧出口
record.description: 离开黄金树大教堂并向电梯方向下行的出口节点。

record.label: 西侧电梯下端
record.description: 电梯下降后的路线节点；之后继续沿楼梯和栏杆方向前进。

record.label: 古兰桑克斯上方栏杆
record.description: 需要从栏杆处向下跳到小平台；该连接是单向跳落。

record.label: 巨矛下方平台
record.description: 从栏杆跳下后的中间落点，再跳到巨矛上。

record.label: 女王闺阁
record.description: 王城路线中位于黄金树大教堂之后的赐福；不把它与王座前 Boss 房混为一层。

record.label: 王座前蒙葛特 Boss 门
record.description: Boss 前的状态节点；到达这里不等于已激活艾尔登王座赐福。

record.label: 艾尔登王座
record.description: 击败蒙葛特后可激活的王座赐福；路线状态与 Boss 前的王座门严格分离。

record.label: 古兰桑克斯的雷电
record.description: 传奇武器目标。玛利喀斯改变王城为灰烬王城后，该目标不可获取。

record.label: Sealed Tunnel
record.description: The Sealed Tunnel grace beside the southern Capital Outskirts moat; illusory walls conceal the dungeon route.

record.label: Outer Wall Phantom Tree
record.description: Capital Outskirts entry landmark.

record.label: Outer Wall Battleground
record.description: Outer-wall arena approach before the capital gate boss.

record.label: Draconic Tree Sentinel
record.description: Capital entry boss gate. The online source names this instance Gnarrl, Draconic Sentinel; the XYZ is the exact-name map point, not a local fog-wall geometry survey.

record.label: East Capital Rampart
record.description: Capital interior arrival after the Draconic Tree Sentinel gate.

record.label: Lower Capital Church
record.description: Lower-city church grace reached from the Avenue Balcony side by a roof/drop route; kept separate from the upper-city main route.

record.label: West Capital Rampart
record.description: The grace reached after climbing the dragon wing from Avenue Balcony; it is the actual hub before Godfrey and Fortified Manor branches.

record.label: Fortified Manor, First Floor
record.description: Optional lower branch from West Capital Rampart; the interior reproduces the Roundtable Hold layout and contains the elevator to Divine Bridge.

record.label: Godfrey, First Elden Lord (golden shade)
record.description: The first Leyndell story boss gate; this golden shade is distinct from Ashen Capital Godfrey / Hoarah Loux.

record.label: Divine Bridge
record.description: Isolated bridge platform reached by the Fortified Manor elevator; its waygate leads to the Isolated Divine Tower.

record.label: Underground Roadside
record.description: Upper sewer grace reached from the Royal Capital street level.

record.label: Forsaken Depths
record.description: Lower sewer grace immediately before the Mohg, the Omen chapel.

record.label: Mohg, the Omen

onlineTextLocation.locationClaim: Chapel beyond the Forsaken Depths grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
onlineTextLocation.reason: The fixed online Boss-position snapshot has no Mohg, the Omen record; the route and chapel location remain text/topology evidence only.

record.description: Mohg, the Omen boss gate below Leyndell.

record.label: Cathedral of the Forsaken
record.description: Post-Mohg cathedral grace and hidden altar entrance.

record.label: Leyndell Catacombs
record.description: Optional catacomb branch entered from the sewer's crayfish room.

record.label: Frenzied Flame Proscription
record.description: Deepest Frenzied Flame grace after the Cathedral altar and beam parkour descent.

record.label: Auriza Hero's Grave surface entrance
record.description: Entrance beneath the north-eastern Leyndell outer wall, reached from the Capital Outskirts cliff route. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

record.label: Auriza Side Tomb surface entrance
record.description: Catacomb entrance on the path north of Auriza Hero's Grave. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

record.label: Capital Rampart
record.description: First capital-rampart grace after the Draconic Tree Sentinel gate, before the East Capital Rampart interior route.

record.label: Hermit Merchant's Shack
record.description: Cliffside merchant grace east/northwest of Outer Wall Battleground; its Bell Bearing Hunter state is an optional night hazard.

record.label: Minor Erdtree Church
record.description: Church grace at the end of the southeast path from Outer Wall Phantom Tree, between the Sealed Tunnel and West Altus tower route.

record.label: Avenue Balcony
record.description: 官方赐福目录补齐节点；位置未在抽象布局中放置。

record.mode: 巨龙石翼上行
record.note: 从大道旁露台沿巨龙石翼向高处路线前进。

record.mode: 树根 / 高架入口
record.note: 经王城高处路线进入黄金树大教堂区域。

record.mode: Avenue Balcony to Lower Capital Church drop
record.note: The lower church is reached from the Avenue Balcony side by the roof/underpass drop; it is modeled as a hazardous optional branch rather than a flat same-floor walk.

record.mode: West Capital Rampart to Fortified Manor
record.note: From West Capital Rampart, pass the gargoyle and descend to the lower area, then climb the stable into the Roundtable Hold replica.

record.mode: West Capital Rampart to Godfrey golden shade
record.note: The tree-root ascent from the rampart reaches the first Leyndell story boss; the Fortified Manor branch remains separate.

record.mode: Godfrey golden shade completion
record.note: The Erdtree Sanctuary grace is the post-Godfrey continuation; it is not placed directly after the dragon wing.

record.mode: Fortified Manor elevator to Divine Bridge
record.note: The lower courtyard elevator rises to Divine Bridge; using this route activates the bridge-side waygate in the modeled state.

record.mode: 西侧出口 / 下楼梯
record.note: 从黄金树大教堂退出并朝电梯方向下行。

record.mode: 电梯下降
record.note: 乘坐大教堂西侧电梯到下层。

record.mode: 下层楼梯 / 栏杆
record.note: 沿下层路线前进到巨矛上方栏杆。

record.mode: 栏杆单向跳落
record.note: 从栏杆跳到下方小平台；不生成反向边。

record.mode: 跳上巨龙石矛
record.note: 沿巨龙石矛向上到达目标物品。

record.mode: 树根上行 / 外部路线
record.note: 从黄金树大教堂沿树根和外部高处路线到女王闺阁。

record.mode: 王座前通路
record.note: 女王闺阁之后到达王座前 Boss 区域；此边只表示到达 Boss 门。

record.mode: 击败蒙葛特后激活赐福
record.note: Boss 房与赐福是两个节点；未击败蒙葛特时不能把艾尔登王座当作已激活终点。

record.mode: Outer Wall Phantom Tree to Sealed Tunnel
record.note: Head southeast through the shallow moat from Outer Wall Phantom Tree to the southern Sealed Tunnel entrance.

record.mode: outer wall approach
record.note: Outskirts route before the capital gate.

record.mode: Draconic Tree Sentinel approach
record.note: Capital gate boss node.

record.mode: capital gate completion
record.note: Post-gate arrival at the Capital Rampart grace; the East Capital Rampart interior is a separate next transition.

record.mode: capital inner route
record.note: Connects the new capital entry slice to the existing Avenue Balcony slice.

record.mode: Avenue Balcony sewer entrance
record.note: The capital street-level entry drops into the upper sewer hall; no surface distance is used for the plane transition.

record.mode: Underground Roadside lower sewer route
record.note: Pipes, ladders and the cage lift descend to Forsaken Depths.

record.mode: Sewer to Leyndell Catacombs branch
record.note: The catacomb entrance is kept as an optional branch from the sewer's lower room.

record.mode: Forsaken Depths to Mohg, the Omen
record.note: The lower cage-lift grace sits immediately before the Forsaken chapel boss route.

record.mode: Mohg, the Omen completion
record.note: The Cathedral of the Forsaken grace appears in the post-boss arena state.

record.mode: Cathedral of the Forsaken altar descent
record.note: The hidden altar route and beam parkour are exposed only after the sewer boss and Morgott state; this is a high-risk one-way descent.

record.mode: East Capital Rampart to Auriza Hero's Grave
record.note: Follow the north-eastern Capital Outskirts cliff and drop to the Hero's Grave entrance.

record.mode: East Capital Rampart to Auriza Side Tomb
record.note: Take the road under the capital bridge and follow the north-curving cliff path past Auriza Hero's Grave.

record.mode: Capital Rampart to East Capital Rampart
record.note: Continue from the outer capital-rampart grace into the East Capital Rampart interior.

record.mode: East Capital Rampart return to Capital Rampart
record.note: Return through the capital rampart connection; this is not a surface route to Altus.

record.mode: Outer Wall Battleground east cliff to Hermit Merchant's Shack
record.note: Head east from Outer Wall Battleground, then turn northwest and climb the cliff to the merchant shack.

record.mode: Hermit Merchant's Shack return to Outer Wall Battleground
record.note: Descend the same cliff route to the battleground grace.

record.mode: Outer Wall Phantom Tree southeast path to Minor Erdtree Church
record.note: Follow the path southeast from Outer Wall Phantom Tree to the church at the route's end.

record.mode: Minor Erdtree Church return to Outer Wall Phantom Tree
record.note: Return northwest along the same outer-wall path.

record.mode: Sealed Tunnel entrance return to Outer Wall Phantom Tree
record.note: Leave the tunnel mouth and return to the Capital Outskirts outer wall.

record.mode: Outer Wall Battleground return to Outer Wall Phantom Tree
record.note: Return along the outer-wall battleground route to the Phantom Tree grace.

record.mode: Avenue Balcony return to East Capital Rampart
record.note: Return up the inner capital stairs to East Capital Rampart.

record.mode: West Capital Rampart return to Dragon Wing
record.note: Descend from the west rampart along the same dragon-wing route; this remains a vertical landmark edge, not a flat map shortcut.

record.mode: Dragon Wing return to Avenue Balcony
record.note: Descend the exposed dragon-wing route back to Avenue Balcony.

record.mode: Fortified Manor return to West Capital Rampart
record.note: Leave the Roundtable Hold replica through the opened manor route and return to the west rampart hub.

record.mode: Divine Bridge elevator return to Fortified Manor
record.note: After the Fortified Manor route has activated the Divine Bridge lift/waygate state, return down the elevator; the sending gate itself remains one-way.

record.mode: Queen's Bedchamber return to Erdtree Sanctuary
record.note: Return down the root and upper-capital walkway to the Erdtree Sanctuary grace.

record.mode: Underground Roadside return to Avenue Balcony
record.note: Climb back through the sewer entrance/well route to Avenue Balcony; this is a layer transition with a high route risk, not a direct surface teleport.

record.mode: Forsaken Depths lift return to Underground Roadside
record.note: Use the same cage-lift, pipe and ladder route to climb back toward the upper sewer hall.

record.mode: Leyndell Catacombs return to Underground Roadside
record.note: Leave the catacomb branch by its lift and pipe route; the shared sewer junction is modeled as Underground Roadside.

record.mode: Cathedral of the Forsaken return to Forsaken Depths
record.note: After Mohg, the Omen is defeated, leave the post-boss cathedral area through the same chapel route to Forsaken Depths; the Frenzied Flame beam descent remains separate and one-way.

record.mode: Lower Capital Church return to Avenue Balcony
record.note: Use the lower-city street, roof and canal route back to Avenue Balcony; this is distinct from the hazardous one-way drop modeled in the opposite direction.

record.label: Divine Bridge waygate active
record.hint: The Fortified Manor elevator route has activated the waygate beside the Divine Bridge golem.

record.label: Draconic Tree Sentinel defeated
record.hint: The formal capital-entry edge is kept closed until the outer-wall gate boss is defeated.

record.label: 已激活黄金树大教堂赐福
record.hint: 从该赐福出发的路线需要玩家已经激活它。

record.label: Godfrey, First Elden Lord defeated
record.hint: The Royal Capital Godfrey golden shade gate has been cleared; the Erdtree Sanctuary route is open.

record.label: Mohg, the Omen defeated
record.hint: The Subterranean Shunning-Grounds cathedral boss has been cleared; the Cathedral grace and Frenzied Flame descent are available.

record.label: 已击败蒙葛特
record.hint: 只有击败王座前的蒙葛特后，才能把艾尔登王座作为已激活赐福目标。

record.label: 王城仍为罗德尔
record.hint: 尚未击败玛利喀斯；目标仍存在于王城罗德尔。
